hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, an enclave of South Africa || mostly highland with plateaus, hills, and mountains || landlocked, surrounded by South Africa; mountainous, more than 80% of the country is 1,800 m (5,900 ft) above sea level || Resources: water, agricultural and grazing land, diamonds, sand, clay, building stone || Exports: diamonds, garments, wool, power equipment, bedding (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly highland with plateaus, hills, and mountains || Southern Africa, an enclave of South Africa

climate.excerpt: temperate; cool to cold, dry winters; hot, wet summers || periodic droughts

economy.excerpt: lower middle-income economy surrounded by South Africa; environmentally fragile and politically unstable; key infrastructure and renewable energy investments; dire poverty; urban job and income losses due to COVID-19; systemic corruption || Exports: diamonds, garments, wool, power equipment, bedding (2023) || Industries: food, beverages, textiles, apparel assembly, handicrafts, construction, tourism

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Sesotho (official), English (official), Phuthi, Xhosa, Zulu || Protestant 47.8% (Pentecostal 23.1%, Lesotho Evangelical 17.3%, Anglican 7.4%), Roman Catholic 39.3%, other Christian 9.1%, non-Christian 1.4%, none 2.3% (2014 est.) || Sotho 99.7%, other 0.3% (includes Kwena, Nguni (Hlubi and Phuthi), Zulu)
